evals.prompt: Review ContentView.swift for SwiftUI best practices. It uses foregroundColor, NavigationView and a custom ForEach(items.indices).
evals.expected_output: Findings grouped by file with line, rule and before/after code, plus a prioritized summary.
expectations: Loads swiftui-specialist soft-deprecated-apis.md or soft-deprecation.md to check the deprecated APIs
Loads swiftui-specialist foreach.md for the index-based ForEach
Output lists file, line, rule and a before/after snippet per issue, and ends with a summary

evals.prompt: Review the strings in this SwiftUI view for localization problems.
evals.expected_output: Localization findings sourced from the specialist's localization reference.
expectations: Loads swiftui-specialist localization.md rather than a swiftui-pro localization file
